# Barline { #timetoalign.timelines.Barline }

```python
timelines.Barline(
    coordinate,
    *,
    id=None,
    seed=None,
    _unknown_keys=dict[str, Any](),
    name=None,
    label=None,
    meta=dict[str, Any](),
    provenance=None,
    manifestation=None,
)
```

A barline the source prints: a double or a final barline.

It changes nothing in the flow.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name          | Type                                                                                    | Description                                                                |
|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| coordinate    | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`)                                             | Where the barline lies.                                                    |
| manifestation | [FlowManifestation](`timetoalign.core.enums.FlowManifestation`) \| [str](`str`) \| None | ``double_barline``, ``final_barline`` or a word outside the vocabulary.    |
| name          | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                    | A display name.                                                            |
| label         | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                    | A human-readable label.                                                    |
| meta          | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\]                                     | Additional metadata.                                                       |
| provenance    | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[Provenance](`timetoalign.core.provenance.Provenance`), ...\] \| None | How the element was made and who believes it: provenance entries, or None. |
| id            | [str](`str`)                                                                            | The element's ID; minted with the prefix ``barline`` when not given.       |
